number.cardQuoteWin: You really cracked it this time!
number.confirmDaily: Switching the daily challenge restarts this round. Continue?
number.confirmMode: Switching modes restarts this round. Continue?
number.confirmDigits: Changing the digit count restarts this round. Continue?
number.settingsNote: Changing the mode or digits restarts this round; opening settings won't interrupt voice.
number.rules1: All digits are different and the first can't be 0. A means right digit, right place; B means right digit, wrong place.
number.rules2: Guess the computer's number, or let your AI friend guess the one in your head. Up to 10 guesses per round.
number.errInvalid: Enter {{n}} different digits; the first can't be 0.
number.errSum: A + B can't exceed the number of digits.
number.errContradict: This hint contradicts earlier A/B results. Check it or undo the last one.
number.errHearNumber: Didn't catch the number. Say each digit again in English, e.g. one three five nine.
number.errHearAB: Didn't catch the A/B. Say it again, e.g. one A two B.
number.dailyNote: Daily puzzle (UTC {{date}}): same answer for everyone at this difficulty. Only your first finish is saved on this device.
number.hintGuess: A = right digit, right place; B = right digit, wrong place. No leading 0, no repeated digits.
number.hintReverse: Think of a number with no repeated digits — don't type or reveal it. Your friend will guess; you just report A/B.
number.reportHint: Compare with your secret number and report how many A and B.
number.empty: No guesses yet — start with your first number.
number.outOfTries: All 10 tries used — try again next time!
number.confirmRestart: A new puzzle clears this round's guesses. Continue?

advance.skip: Skipped — on to the next word.

taboo.violation: You said the taboo word “{{term}}” — minus 5 points.
taboo.noGuess: {{name}} hasn't got it yet — try another clue.
taboo.offlineClear: Offline self-practice: your clue is already specific. Keep practicing or score it yourself.
taboo.offlineVague: Offline self-practice: say more about its use, look, or context. No AI guesses in this mode.
taboo.aiFailed: The AI can't guess right now. Try again, or confirm with “Friend got it”.
taboo.tryAgain: Try again! The second clue is now showing.

fb.zhNoSample1: Describe what the object is for and what makes it special so it's easier to guess.
fb.zhNoSample2: Add context and detail in full Chinese sentences.
fb.enNoSample1: Explaining the use in full English sentences is easier to guess than single words.
fb.enNoSample2: Next time try “It is used for…” or “You can find it in…”.
fb.preparingEn: Preparing feedback on your spoken English…
fb.zhFallback1: Describe what the object does first, then its appearance.
fb.zhFallback2: Try explaining the context in full Chinese sentences.

taboo.generated: Generated a new English word and taboo list.
taboo.generateFailed: Generation failed. Keeping the built-in word — keep playing.
taboo.confirmMode: This round isn't over. Switching modes discards your score and progress. Switch anyway?
taboo.deckLabel: Game mode · using the {{lang}} word deck
taboo.settingsLocked: Round in progress. Settings unlock next round so you don't interrupt by accident.
taboo.settingsNext: Settings apply to the next 5-word challenge.
taboo.rules1: I describe: describe the target word in {{lang}} without saying the taboo words. With a key, your friend really guesses; without one, it's description practice with self-scoring.
taboo.rules2: Friend describes: read or listen to the {{lang}} clues and guess the word.
taboo.rules3: 5 words per round: +10 for correct, −5 for a violation, 3 skips. Gemini Live voice is optional; text mode works too.

welcome.zhDescribe: Let your friend guess from your Chinese description
welcome.enDescribe: Let your friend guess from your English description
welcome.zhGuess: Guess from your friend's Chinese clues
welcome.enGuess: Guess the word from your friend's English clues
welcome.zhDescribeBody: You can see the answer and taboo words. Describe it in Chinese and your friend will guess.
welcome.zhSelfBody: You can see the answer and taboo words. Describe freely and score yourself — no AI guessing without a key.
welcome.enDescribeBody: You can see the answer and taboo words. Describe it in English and your friend guesses one word — no small talk.
welcome.enSelfBody: You can see the answer and taboo words. Practice describing in English and score yourself; AI guessing needs a Gemini key.
welcome.zhGuessBody: You only see Chinese clues — guess the answer in Chinese.
welcome.enGuessBody: You only see English clues. Listen, then try saying the target word.

taboo.practiceAi: AI guessing mode: your friend reads your description and guesses. Live voice is optional.
taboo.practiceNoKey: No key · self-practice: taboo-word checks and manual scoring — no fake AI guesses. Add a Gemini key to let your friend really guess.
taboo.describeEyebrow: describe in {{lang}}, don't say the answer
taboo.describeTip: Describe its use, look, or where it's used; add clues if your friend is stuck.
taboo.needHelp: Need help? Show the second clue
taboo.guessTip: Say or type your answer. Chinese or English equivalents and a short “I think it's…” are accepted.
taboo.tipAi: Type or use Live voice to describe; the AI guesses.
taboo.tipNoKey: Without a key you can type, practice, and self-score; your friend won't guess automatically.
taboo.tipGuess: Use voice (needs a key) or just type.
